follow-up time: 3 months before and after COVID-19 outbreak (January-June 2020), compared to the same period in 2019
outcome: Utilization of healthcare services (consultations, surgeries, deliveries, C-sections, penta-3rd dose immunisation)
cohort: Patients at 127 public hospitals in Yemen
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic led to a significant decline in consultations, surgeries, and penta-3rd dose immunizations in Yemen, but not in deliveries or C-sections.
mod_finding: Deliveries and C-section services remained nearly at the same level and were not affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
